purpose: measure the locked source without generating a new fish
panels: live 3D source viewer with fixed views and source nodes
GoldenZtuff published side render with click measurement
fork-length calibration from user-selected snout and caudal fork center
dorsal and ventral finlet click inventory
rules: Image measurements are valid only after explicit fork-length calibration on the same render.
Image FL-normalized measurements remain 2D projection evidence, not 3D distances.
3D viewer raw-node measurements remain in their own coordinate frame.
Normalized benchmark anchors remain a third evidence class.
Never mix the three frames without a documented transform.
